subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI tracker stay open as the umbrella, or be split/closed in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 after maintainers confirm ownership?
rationale: The remaining work crosses chat.send protocol shape, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide and land the structured reply metadata and durable final fallback paths.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata and final-fallback trackers fully own the two halves.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Quote UI
options.body: Treat the current Markdown quote behavior as enough for Control UI replies, intentionally dropping the structured metadata ask.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide and land the structured reply metadata and durable final fallback paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and related PR history put vincentkoc on both the current source snapshot and recent Control UI reply hardening, making them the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
